result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered. The one clear visual defect is the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now', which shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo. Other elements (carousels, chips, bottom card) follow expected patterns.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a generic broken-image placeholder icon on a grey background instead of the restaurant's hero photo, while neighboring cards load their images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL/asset for this restaurant and fix the failed load; provide a branded fallback image or the restaurant logo instead of a raw broken-image icon when the photo is unavailable.
